inventory.scope: Bounded official reference corpus and pinned native help; CLI first

implemented: Plan, apply, sync, import, and legacy export refusals
Preservation of canonical policy, native settings, and ownership on refusal
Named extensions with required and optional diagnostics
Pinned Codex Linux direct-shell security projection
Native authority and prerequisite checks with an exact invocation contract
Owned security segments, removal, backup, and rollback
Explicit process runtime grant and workspace alias checks
Native enforcement, refusal, and lifecycle scenario classification
Native model-tool allow/deny and unattended approval assessment with correlated tool evidence
not_implemented: Security projection outside the Codex direct-shell subset
Portable model-tool approval rules and exact-command permissions
Credential isolation and default-deny filesystem mapping
Security coverage for hooks, MCP, LSP, or delegation
IDE, cloud, or non-Linux security adapters

native_observations.codex: Direct-shell subset: 27 sandbox observations, 23 refusal checks, and 9 lifecycle checks passed. Separate native model-tool allow and explicit denial tests passed; on-request does not preserve portable unattended ask.
native_observations.copilot: Native path denial blocks the named host Unix socket, but TCP/UDP/IPv6 loopback remains allowed. Native model-tool allow, explicit denial, and unattended denial were observed; portable security remains refused.

later_phases: Broader native authority, model-tool and approval scopes, and Copilot local-network mapping
Plugins, LSP, automation, and remote extensions
Public proposal, comment period, and governance decision
